content.title: Signalling proposal: Kick off LikeCoin v3 token migration and use v3 token as basis of governance
content.description:
Background:

 With LikeCoin v3 preparation work coming to an end, the final step is to open the migration app to Likers and encourage Likers to migrate their tokens within 90 days. Since there will be no incentive for LikeCoin chain validators to maintain their servers after the subsidize period, LikeCoin chain may be stopped any time after migration. Likers are strongly advised to take action within the 90-day migration period, after which their tokens will likely be gone forever.

 OTOH as migration starts, the LikeCoin DAO will have to agree to obsolete the v2 governance procedures and switch to v3 governance instead. Snapshot will be used for proposals submission and voting - https://snapshot.box/#/s:`likerland.eth

 Proposal:

 By passing this proposal, the LikeCoin DAO agrees:

 - to kick off LikeCoin v3 token migration on 2025.11.03, and provide a 90-day window for Likers to migrate their LIKE to v3 before 2026.02.02.

 - to obsolete the LikeCoin v2 governance procedure since 2025.11.03 and switch to LikeCoin v3 governance on Snapshot.

content.title: Signalling proposal: Allocation of 10,000,000 LIKE as v3 staking incentive
content.description:
Background:

LikeCoin v3 token migration is expected to start in Nov 2025. This proposal seeks to allocate 10,000,000 LIKE as an incentive for 90 days, for Likers to migrate their LIKE to v3 early, stake them for a yield and participate in governance.

As a reference, the inflation rate of LikeCoin chain was 3% and is minting about 43.800,000 new LIKE per year, i.e. 10,800,000 LIKE in 90 days. Therefore, a 90-day 10,000,000 LIKE incentive program gives roughly same staking yield as in v2, assuming the staking ratio is similar.

Upon the passing of this proposal, 10,000,000 LIKE will be assigned to a staking contract, to which Likers may stake their LIKE to participate in governance. Rouhgly 111,111 LIKE will be distributed daily to the stakers on a pro rata basis. Stakers may claim their rewards in the staking interface. The staking contract and user interface will be responsible by the Tech Subdao.

content.title: Signalling Proposal: Update the Calculation Basis for the Validator Compensation Mechanism in LikeCoin V3 Update to 7%
content.description:
By voting "Yes" on this proposal, you are indicating your agreement to update the inflation rate calculation basis in the compensation measures outlined in #90 to 7% starting in August, effective prior to the commencement of the transitional arrangements. This will result in an increase in the monthly compensation amount distributed to validators. 

However, it will not backfill compensation already distributed for June and July.

For the specific calculations of quantitative changes and the rationale behind proposing this amendment, please refer to the article in the appendix. 

 - https://matters.town/a/cw5sjcmrhxkg
